title: Seniors Energy Rebate: Common questions
summary: This page provides common questions and information regarding the Seniors Energy Rebate.
what_you_need: NSW Photo Card (physical or digital), including full name and date of birth
NSW Firearms licence, including full name and date of birth
Australian birth certificate from any state or territory (birth extracts and commemorative birth certificates are not acceptable)
Australian certificate of registration by descent

how_to_steps.text: take a photo of your bill with your phone, or scan it using your printer or scanner. Save the bill as one file or save each page of your bill separately
send it to an email account you can access on your computer or tablet. If this isn’t possible, ask your energy provider to send you a copy of the bill by email.
be saved in one of the following formats: JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG, TIF.
be less than 6 MB in size
not have any spaces or special characters in the file name.
open the email on a computer or tablet
open and save the image of your document as a JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG or TIF file.
